author: Goessmann
highlights: High-risk bettors receive more targeted prompts
body: AI-driven personalization increases sportsbook engagement by tailoring promotions to user behavior. That targeting can intensify gambling habits, especially for users already showing risky patterns.

tag: State-level rehab funding solves addiction harms
author: Blair
highlights: States can tailor funding to need
body: State governments are well positioned to fund treatment programs for gambling addiction and tailor services to local needs. Local administration is more flexible than a national ban.
